rank_correction.reason: At each cutoff dlogC = dlogN + (-dlogPplus), creating two exact column dependencies.
rank_correction.interpretation: The matrix attains its algebraic maximum; this is not evidence of hidden low-rank collapse.

conclusion: Orbit persistence is supported, especially for [0,3,6]. The original two-step rank test is structurally non-diagnostic because of exact column redundancy.
next_target: Three-step N8->N9, N9->N10, N10->N11 persistence with an independent-response matrix using only dlogN and -dlogPplus at each cutoff.
